description: STPI will implement the Bhubaneswar centre under the IndiaAI Mission, with Blue Cloud providing funding, industry leadership, mentorship and strategic support to startups
body_lead: Odisha AI CoE gets MeitY nod, Blue Cloud to invest ₹4 crore in centre STPI will implement the Bhubaneswar centre under the IndiaAI Mission, with Blue Cloud providing funding, industry leadership, mentorship and strategic support to startups Listen to This Article The proposed Centre of Excellence (CoE) in artificial intelligence (AI-CoE) in Bhubaneswar has received in-principle approval from the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), paving the way for the establishment of a dedicated platform for applied artificial intelligence innovation, startup incubation and...
